title: Adding extra mods
summary: Run your server with more mods than the Burning Empires core.

sections.heading: Setups
steps: Open the Mods page.
Burning Empires is locked. It runs Burning Empires with Elephants, its Coop compat, Harmony, ButterLib, UIExtenderEx and MCM.
For your own mods, click New setup or Copy. Rename gives it a name.
sections.tip: Locked setups show a Locked tag. Copy one to change its mods or their order.

sections.heading: Add and order mods
steps: Click Add mods, pick the mods, then click Save mods.
Use the arrows to move a mod, the On box to switch it off, and ✕ to remove it. The mod stays installed.
Extra mods go before Coop or after Burning Empires. Nothing goes between the Coop compat and Burning Empires.
Click Auto sort to order the extra mods from what each mod says it needs. The Burning Empires core does not move.
Install mods downloads the Workshop mods of the setup you do not have yet.

sections.heading: Share with your players
steps: Click Share mod list. It saves a file your players can open with Import mod list in the client launcher.
Players need the same mods in the same order, or the server turns the join down.
The Mods page says which mods players have to get from Nexus Mods or ModDB.

sections.heading: Done for you
steps: Extra mods are unblocked when the server starts. Unblock DLLs on the Settings page does it by hand.
When a setup adds mods to a campaign, the tool asks once and keeps a copy of the save first.
A mod that brings its own copy of Harmony, ButterLib or UIExtenderEx is marked as a clash.

sections.heading: Badges
steps: Each mod shows a badge from the community Burning Empires list, like Tested safe, Risky or Known broken.
Hover a badge to read its note. Mods no list knows show Unknown, not tested.
Next to it you see your own result, like Passed on your server.

sections.heading: Test mods on the server
steps: Stop the server and pick a Server copy save.
Click Test mods on the server, tick the mods and click Start test.
Each mod runs alone with the Burning Empires core on a copy of your save. Your real saves are not written.
Players cannot join while the test runs.
